tweets.content: Why does Binance's market share grow so quickly in new sectors? Short answer: users. Some exchanges extract maximum profit from their users, max fees, some even trade against their users while offering 0-fees or 100% rebate to referrers. But they can't keep the users. Protect users = protect your future businesses, even the ones you haven't launched yet.
tweets.translated: 为什么币安在新领域的市场份额增长如此之快？简短的回答：用户。一些交易所从用户那里获取最大利润和最高费用，有些交易所甚至与用户进行交易，同时向推荐人提供 0 费用或 100% 回扣。但他们留不住用户。保护用户=保护您未来的业务，即使是您尚未启动的业务。

tweets.content: $NBIS outlook is pretty insane yet again. $582.3M revenue (+454% Y/Y, +46% Q/Q) off ~50% adjusted EBITDA margin (AI Cloud). $8.04B cash on hand. Reiterates financial guide (2026 revenue: $3.0–$3.4B 2026 EoY ARR: $7–$9B), I was hoping for a raise, but it's already massive growth. Not really about this quarter financials, but these signals: - "We could sell our entire 2027 capacity on these terms today." massive visibility on demand - "4 customer agreements averaging over $1B+ each in contract value" - Around 70% of Q2 deals included customer prepayments - Contracted power guidance was raised again, from more ~4+ GW to 5 GW. (this used to be a concern vs. $IREN debate, but Nebius power guidance keeps going through the roof). - Expects $9B+ of prepayments in 2026 and says it has $40B+ of commitments. - annual contract value per MW keeps going brrr (>$40M/mw for Q3 short term capacity deals) Same bear story will always be there (eg. large $5.66B of capex with current GAAP net loss), but demand is extreme with massive visibility, with increasing AI Cloud adjusted EBITDA margins ( 24% -> 45% -> 50% progression) We kinda got this read through from all your hyperscaler cloud earnings and $CRWV backlog yesterday, but glad it's showing up in Weebius's earnings.
tweets.translated: $NBIS 的前景再次相当疯狂。调整后 EBITDA 利润率约为 50%（AI Cloud），收入为 5.823 亿美元（同比增长 454%，季度增长 46%）。 $8.04B 手头现金。重申财务指南（2026年收入：$3.0–$3.4B 2026 EoY ARR：$7–$9B），我希望加薪，但它已经是巨大的增长。其实并不是关于本季度的财务数据，而是这些信号：“我们今天可以按照这些条件出售 2027 年的全部产能。”按需提供大量可见性 - “4 个客户协议的合同价值平均超过 10 亿美元以上” - 第二季度交易中大约 70% 包括客户预付款 - 合同电力指引再次上调，从约 4+ 吉瓦提高到 5 吉瓦。 （这曾经是与 $IREN 争论的一个问题，但 Nebius 功率指导一直在飙升）。 - 预计 2026 年预付款额将达到 9B+ 美元，并表示已承诺支付 40B+ 美元。 - 每兆瓦的年度合同价值持续增长（第三季度短期产能交易>4000万美元/兆瓦）同样的熊市故事将永远存在（例如，当前 GAAP 净亏损的资本支出高达 5.66B 美元），但随着 AI 云调整后 EBITDA 利润率的增加（24% -> 45% -> 50% 的进展），需求是极端的，可见度很高（24% -> 45% -> 50%），我们从所有超大规模云收入和 $CRWV 中读到了这一点昨天积压了订单，但很高兴它出现在威比斯的收益中。

tweets.content: So this is just what I'm seeing with $SIVE and the CW DFB laser chokepoint right now. From optical earnings: 1. $LITE: unexpected demand and imbalance for UHP CW lasers. - Had ability to price up ASP for lasers. - Scale up CPO on track for H2 2027 shipments, called out any CPO scale up delay rumors as noise. Lumentum confirmed timelines (that CPO players like Sivers sold off of misleading reports from), high margins, and extreme demand for qualified CW lasers. 2. $AAOI: doesn’t have enough CW laser capacity because of too much optical transceiver demand. - Not meaningfully participating in first-gen CPO deployments, with $MTSI not looking like they're in it either but focusing on NPO. Haven't seen much with $SMTC after their HieFo acqusition. - Called lasers as the bottleneck within a 20-40% demand imbalance for transceivers. - Says customers approaching them every week asking them for supply + to move faster. AOI confirmed demand imbalances + bottlenecks for lasers. And we got an even smaller pool for first-gen CPO players. 3. Both $AAOI and $LITE claimed Chinese players were years behind for CPO lasers and far behind stated claims in qualified capacity. - $AAOI said 2-3 years+ behind with CPO lasers. - $LITE said they haven't seen anything like Chinese claims in terms of outputs (and no recourse if it's false). Reaffirms moat for CPO related lasers, and no flooding from some shortseller claims on the optical sector. 4. $MTSI said that many customers are approaching them with urgency due to the general supply shortage of indium phosphide DFB lasers. Again, puts Sivers in the that bottleneck, giving them likely more customer demand . Among $COHR ($72.54B), $LITE ($66.57B), $AVGO ($2.13T): It's very special you get one of the public 4 Western CPO leaders at a ~$1.5B MC with $SIVE. Feels like my thesis with both: - The CW bottleneck that I predicted - CW laser chokepoint (where there's only a few CPO players, at least for gen-1) Got validated from earnings, now it's just waiting for the inflection points of next optical architecture shifts.
tweets.translated: 这就是我现在在 $SIVE 和 CW DFB 激光阻塞点上看到的情况。来自光学收益： 1. $LITE：UHP CW 激光器的意外需求和不平衡。 - 有能力提高激光器的平均售价。 - 扩大原棕油的出货量有望在 2027 年下半年实现，称任何原棕油扩大规模延迟的传言都是噪音。 Lumentum 证实了时间表（像 Sivers 这样的 CPO 参与者出售了误导性报告）、高利润以及对合格连续激光器的极端需求。 2. $AAOI：由于光收发器需求太多，没有足够的连续激光器产能。 - 没有有意义地参与第一代 CPO 部署，$MTSI 看起来也没有参与其中，而是专注于 NPO。在 $SMTC 收购 HieFo 后，我们对他们的了解并不多。 - 认为激光器是收发器需求不平衡 20-40% 的瓶颈。 - 说客户每周都会联系他们，要求他们提供供应+加快行动速度。 AOI 证实了激光器的需求不平衡和瓶颈。我们为第一代 CPO 玩家提供的池子甚至更小。 3. $AAOI 和 $LITE 都声称中国厂商在 CPO 激光器方面落后了很多年，而且在合格产能方面也远远落后于所声称的水平。 - $AAOI 表示 CPO 激光器落后 2-3 年以上。 - $LITE 表示，他们还没有看到任何像中国在产出方面所声称的东西（如果它是错误的，则没有追索权）。重申了 CPO 相关激光器的护城河，并且光学行业的一些卖空者声明不会造成泛滥。 4. $MTSI表示，由于磷化铟DFB激光器普遍供应短缺，许多客户正在紧急联系他们。再次，西弗斯陷入了瓶颈，给他们带来了更多的客户需求。在 $COHR ($72.54B)、$LITE ($66.57B)、$AVGO ($2.13T) 中：非常特别的是，你在 $SIVE 的 ~$1.5B MC 中获得了 4 位西方 CPO 领导者之一。感觉就像我的论文： - 我预测的 CW 瓶颈 - CW 激光阻塞点（只有少数 CPO 参与者，至少对于第一代）已从收益中得到验证，现在只是等待下一个光学架构转变的拐点。
